Role Management nằm trong User page hay nested route riêng?

handoff.purpose: Allow another AI model or developer to resume without reconstructing the full conversation.
readProtocol: Verify repositories.application.headCommit against actual main HEAD.
If HEAD matches, use requests/currentState/acceptanceSuites to determine current work and accepted evidence.
Read only the protected CVF sections listed in requiredReads for the active request.
Inspect only the affected source files listed in the active request.
Do not reopen accepted scopes unless a concrete regression or SPEC conflict is found.
After implementation, update request status, commit evidence, acceptance cases and changelog in this file.
